newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita to triple investment in LCD plant - paper.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita to triple investment in LCD plant - paper.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd plans to invest 20 billion yen in its liquid crystal display (LCD) production facilities in the business year starting in April, triple the amount of the current year, a newspaper said on Tuesday.

The company will build a new production line for thin film transistors (TFTs), currently the most advanced type of LCD, in its Ishimawa factory in northwestern Japan, the business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
The new line, which is expected to start operating in July, will have the capacity to make 90,000 LCDs a month, it said.
Matsushita expects to produce about 65 billion yen worth of LCDs this business year, and aims for annual sales of 150 billion yen by the 2000/01 business year, it said.
